tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background in voter and admin mode. Light is warm paper, like the receipt.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the receipt slip, drawers and table rows.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Input wells, table header rows, the code-entry field background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and completed-stage marks, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk (13:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, hints, captions, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk and stage-done (4.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons) and the upcoming-stage ring; 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: The one signature accent as a FILL: primary buttons (text in on-accent) and large brand blocks. Never as text, and in light mode never as a small mark on its own (2.7:1).

tokens.name: accent-mark
tokens.usage: Small marks that carry meaning: the current-stage dot and ring, active tab underline (3:1 or better on every surface).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange text: the current stage's label and inline emphasis, on any surface (4.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-orange fills (5.3:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element (5.2:1 or better on every surface).

tokens.name: stage-done
tokens.usage: Fill behind completed stages and the progress line; ink on it is 10:1 or better.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Soft orange fill behind the current stage row and the current-stage badge; accent-text (4.9:1+) and ink read on it.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Floating dark surfaces: the batch action pill, the digital receipt pass, the tracker hero card.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse (11.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse (6.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: status-challenged
tokens.usage: Challenged status text and icon, on surface or status-challenged-bg. Always with the flag icon and the word Challenged.

tokens.name: status-challenged-bg
tokens.usage: Challenged badge and callout fill.

tokens.name: status-discarded
tokens.usage: Discarded status and failed integrity checks, text and icon. Always with the X icon, the word and the reason.

tokens.name: status-discarded-bg
tokens.usage: Discarded badge and failed-check callout fill.

tokens.name: status-spoiled
tokens.usage: Spoiled status text and icon, with the return-arrow icon and the word Spoiled.

tokens.name: status-spoiled-bg
tokens.usage: Spoiled badge fill.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one status headline at the top of the tracker.

styles.name: body-lg

styles.usage: Voter-mode body copy and stage notes. Voter screens never go below this for sentences.

styles.name: heading

styles.name: body

styles.name: small

styles.name: code-lg
styles.usage: The tracking code on the receipt and the tracker. Mono so 0/O and 1/l/I differ.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Hashes, record IDs and codes inside tables.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, table containers, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-lg

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, stage circles, the floating batch bar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on surface. Cards separate by soft elevation, not borders.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating elements: the batch bar, dialogs, the receipt pass.
